newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-S.A. TO PLAY FIVE HOME TESTS IN 1997-98.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-S.A. TO PLAY FIVE HOME TESTS IN 1997-98.

text.p: South Africa are scheduled to play five cricket tests against Pakistan and Sri Lanka during the 1997-98 season, the United Cricket Board of South Africa (UCBSA) announced on Wednesday.
South Africa will also play 10 one-day internationals in a triangular series involving both Pakistan and Sri Lanka in April of 1998, the UCBSA said in a statement.
Tour itinerary to South Africa for 1997-98:
January 29 - Pakistan vs Nicky Oppenheimer XI, Randjesfontein
January 31-February 3 - Pakistan vs Griqualand West, Kimberley
February 6-9 - Pakistan vs Border, East London
February 13-17 - Pakistan vs South Africa, first test, Johannesburg
February 20-23 - Pakistan vs Free State, Bloemfontein
February 26-March 2 - Pakistan vs South Africa, second test, Durban
March 6-10 - Pakistan vs South Africa, third test, Port Elizabeth
March 7-9 - Sri Lanka vs Transvaal, Johannesburg
March 11 - Sri Lanka vs North West, Fochville
March 14-16 - Sri Lanka vs Boland, Paarl
March 19-23 - Sri Lanka vs South Africa, first test, Cape Town
March 27-31 - Sri Lanka vs South Africa, second test, Centurion
Triangular series:
April 3 - South Africa vs Pakistan, Durban
April 5 - South Africa vs Sri Lanka, Johannesburg
April 7 - Sri Lanka vs Pakistan, Kimberley
April 9 - Sri Lanka vs Pakistan, Paarl
April 11 - South Africa vs Pakistan, East London
April 13 - South Africa vs Sri Lanka, Port Elizabeth
April 15 - Sri Lanka vs Pakistan, Benoni
April 17 - South Africa vs Pakistan, Centurion
April 19 - South Africa vs Sri Lanka, Bloemfontein
April 22 - Final, Cape Town
April 23 - Final (alternate day)
